The patient with known Sturge-Weber syndrome and prior outpatient evaluation for congenital melanocytic nevus presents to the emergency department.
The birthmark covers her right forehead and upper eyelid and has been present since birth.
Her parents report that the infant has been experiencing episodes where she suddenly stiffens and her right arm jerks for a few minutes.
These episodes have been increasing in frequency over the past month.
